test_title: PYST 2: SSC JE EE - Reasoning (Held on: 15 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some lights are fans.

All fans are switches.

All wires are lights.

**Conclusions:**

I. All wires are fans.

II. Some wires are switches.

III. Some lights are switches.

options.text: Only conclusions I and III follow.
Only conclusions II and III follows.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram of given statements is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e968ba16866c5a07c7f2784f0b299d2b90a99cc1e7549b6186d5a3391893615.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All wires are fans.→ False(As there is no definite relation between them as shown above)

II. Some wires are switches.→ False( There is not any definite relation between wires and switches)

III. Some lights are switches.→ True(As some lights are fans and all fans are switches. So it is possible as shown above in Venn diagram)

Only conclusion III follows.

Hence, **"Option 4" **is the **correct answer.**
